plan: Drive: from Telegraph Creek, about 106 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 57.18176, -131.41897, pull off on an unnamed paved road. Map links below.
Walk: 5.4 km N, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 684 m, about 176 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 280 m NE of the spot at 295 m (57.22762, -131.38159). Water: unnamed wetland 30 m NW (estimate).
Hunt: ducks, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Set up on the shore with the wind at your back: ducks land into the wind (Tip). Shoot only birds you can retrieve.
Use: 12 gauge, steel 2 to 4 (non toxic shot only), modified or improved cylinder rated for steel, plugged to 3 shells (regs).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 6-21, Region 6. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2024-10-08, closures 2026-10-16.
R6O-duck-backcountry-0001.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 6-21: about 1,190 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.07 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: more than 5 km from a drivable road. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).
